steps.name: gsc-url-inspection
steps.summary: scripts/check-indexing-status.ts: quota-efficient URL Inspection API script that checks only recently-added tools (30-day window, EN+KO) and previously not-indexed URLs, merging results into /data/indexing-status.json; googleAuth.ts updated with optional scopes param for webmasters (non-readonly) scope

steps.name: gsc-sitemap-notify
steps.summary: scripts/notify-gsc-reindex.ts: uses Search Console Sitemaps API (PUT /webmasters/v3/sites/.../sitemaps/...) instead of deprecated ping endpoint (retired June 2023); deploy.yml gets 'Notify GSC' step after IndexNow; collect-data.yml gets 'Check GSC indexing status' step between analytics collection and processing, with data/indexing-status.json added to commit
